Message:
docs(Maintain): Fix typo, update Rest/Output descriptions, and add CHANGELOG link

Fix the typo "pipeliens" to "pipelines" in the determinism rationale section of the README.

Update the Rest project link description from "TypeScript compiler" to "HTTP/REST API Server for Land" to accurately reflect Rest's role as an OXC-based JS bundler that serves bundled VS Code platform code to Cocoon.

Update the Output link description from "Build artifact pipeline" to "Build Output & Artifact Management for Land" and add a direct link to CHANGELOG.md in the Related Documentation section for easy access to version history.
